title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.09146v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. This is especially concerning in medicine, where new clinical evidence, updated guidelines, and new therapies can change established practice. Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. translated_title: 冻结模型、进化专长：面向多模态医疗AI的模型无关部署经验学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.09146v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）在部署后通常被冻结，因此无法从其处理的案例中学习。这在医学领域尤为令人担忧，因为新的临床证据、更新的指南和新疗法可能会改变既定的临床实践。微调可以更新模型，但需要访问模型权重并进行额外训练。无参数方法虽避免了训练，但可能过拟合固定的验证集、缺乏可靠的领域知识，或因仅以文本形式保存经验而丢失视觉细节。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个模型无关的框架，使冻结的LLM和VLM能够通过三种形式的外部专业知识从部署经验中学习：引导推理和工具使用的技能、存储由早期案例或可信外部证据支持的可靠事实的知识记忆库，以及保存视觉示例的多模态知识库……
tldr: 提出了一种模型无关的框架，使冻结的大语言模型和视觉语言模型无需微调即可通过技能、知识记忆库和多模态知识库三种外部专业知识从部署经验中持续学习，以适应医学领域不断更新的临床知识。
en_tdlr: A model-agnostic framework enables frozen LLMs and VLMs to continually learn from deployment experience without fine-tuning, leveraging three forms of external expertise—Skills, Knowledge Memory, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base—to adapt to evolving clinical knowledge in medicine.
